description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing a test server connection, including WebSocket transport, event handling, and message communication for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestServerConnectionClosedError
classes.description: Custom error class indicating the test server connection has been closed.

classes.name: TestServerTransport
classes.description: Interface defining methods for test server transport mechanisms.

classes.name: WebSocketTestServerTransport
classes.description: Implementation of TestServerTransport using WebSocket for communication.

classes.name: TestServerConnection
classes.description: Main class managing the test server connection, message handling, and event dispatching.

methods.name: TestServerConnectionClosedError
methods.description: Constructor for the custom error class.

methods.name: onmessage
methods.description: Registers a listener for incoming WebSocket messages.

methods.name: onopen
methods.description: Registers a listener for WebSocket open event.

methods.name: onerror
methods.description: Registers a listener for WebSocket error event.

methods.name: onclose
methods.description: Registers a listener for WebSocket close event.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends data through the WebSocket.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Returns whether the connection is closed.

methods.name: _sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message with a method and optional parameters, awaiting response.

methods.name: _sendMessageNoReply
methods.description: Sends a message without waiting for a reply.

methods.name: _dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches events based on received message method.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the test server connection with parameters.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message to the server.

methods.name: pingNoReply
methods.description: Sends a ping message without expecting a reply.

methods.name: watch
methods.description: Starts watching for test server events.

methods.name: watchNoReply
methods.description: Starts watching without expecting a reply.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a connection or resource on the test server.

methods.name: openNoReply
methods.description: Opens without expecting a reply.

methods.name: resizeTerminal
methods.description: Resizes the terminal on the test server.

methods.name: resizeTerminalNoReply
methods.description: Resizes terminal without reply.

methods.name: checkBrowsers
methods.description: Checks available browsers on the test server.

methods.name: installBrowsers
methods.description: Installs browsers on the test server.

methods.name: runGlobalSetup
methods.description: Runs global setup procedures.

methods.name: runGlobalTeardown
methods.description: Runs global teardown procedures.

methods.name: startDevServer
methods.description: Starts a development server.

methods.name: stopDevServer
methods.description: Stops the development server.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears cache on the server.

methods.name: listFiles
methods.description: Lists files on the server.

methods.name: listTests
methods.description: Lists tests on the server.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Runs tests on the server.

methods.name: findRelatedTestFiles
methods.description: Finds related test files.

methods.name: stopTests
methods.description: Stops running tests.

methods.name: stopTestsNoReply
methods.description: Stops tests without reply.

methods.description: Closes the connection gracefully.
